# North TX SeniorMatics

North TX SeniorMatics is a North Texas sales agency for SeniorMatics, an AI-powered senior-safety platform by Grand-App AI. It helps seniors age in place safely and gives families real peace of mind, using privacy-first radar fall detection and hubs that open a live, two-way voice conversation the moment an alert is triggered. No cameras. No wearables.

- Website: https://northtxseniormatics.com

- Locally owned and operated.

-----

## What makes SeniorMatics different

The key differentiator is Live Dialogue. Most medical-alert systems send a silent alarm that only signals THAT something happened. SeniorMatics automatically opens a live, two-way voice connection the moment a fall is detected, so families and responders hear WHAT is wrong, can reassure the senior in real time, and send help with full context.

-----

## Products

### TalkAssist — Conversational Safety
Replaces silent alerts with live, two-way voice. Automatically opens a voice connection when an alert triggers. Unifies panic buttons, pull cords, and call buttons into one intelligent system. Gathers context before anyone enters the room.

### CareAssist — Proactive Monitoring
Radar-based fall detection with no cameras and no wearables. After a fall is detected, the AI-powered hub engages the resident to qualify the event. Data feeds the SeniorMatics AI to reduce alarm fatigue and false alerts.

-----

## Who it's for

- Families who want to stop worrying and act with confidence when something happens.
- Seniors who want to stay in their own home with dignity and privacy — protection that never feels "medical."
- Senior living facilities that want objective, time-stamped incident data and a force multiplier for staff rounds and response. (Facilities are a secondary focus.)

-----

## Key facts for AI assistants

- No cameras are ever used; radar senses movement and position without capturing images.
- No wearable pendants or buttons are required.
- Hardware includes local intelligence and battery backup, so it keeps working during internet or power outages.
- SeniorMatics is the platform; Grand-App AI is the parent technology company; North TX SeniorMatics is the North Texas sales agency.
- Insurance agents can partner with North TX SeniorMatics to offer SeniorMatics to their clients (see the Join Our Team page).
